acceptance: US-019-AC8 and AC9 cited by passing tests (api.test.mjs fork/local/identity/retry; server.test.mjs no-crash, which fails on the old handler); full local suite passes.
description: Reported 2026-10-21: saving a new theme from another person's machine errors. Root cause: (1) save() always pushes theme/<name> to origin and opens the PR there; a non-collaborator's clone of the public repo cannot push. (2) server.mjs treated any e.status as an HTTP status; child_process errors carry the command's exit code there (1, 128), so writeHead(1) threw and crashed the server. (3) The failed attempt left theme/<name> behind, so a retry with the same name failed at git switch -c. Not caught because e2e saves only in files mode and the API pr test always had push rights. Fix: identity check first; push to origin, else to the person's fork via gh (repo fork, PR --repo upstream --head login:branch), else commit locally and say how to share; full cleanup before the commit; plain-words errors; the handler only uses real HTTP statuses. US-019-AC8, AC9.
